facts.fact: ZIMSTAT and POTRAZ jointly released the 2025 ICT Access by Households and Use by Individuals Survey, a nationwide survey of 9,245 households in all 10 provinces with a 91.3% response rate; no exact release date is given, so the document's published date is used.
